hook: Bakalar leads AI ethics at OpenAI after nearly four years as Chief Ethicist at Meta, where she moved from Responsible AI research into leading ethics across GenAI Trust and Safety and Meta Superintelligence Labs. She holds a PhD in Political Science from the University of Pennsylvania and spent seven years on the faculty at Temple University before moving into industry.
